missing_fields: Supplied main only: one publisher cover plus three article pages. Cited sources and any SI remain unreviewed.
Target mass, pressing pressure, die, sintering atmosphere/ramp/cooling are unreported.
Substrate dimensions, laser pulse energy/fluence, spot size, deposition duration, target–substrate distance and deposition gas/pressure are unreported.
The 3 × 10^-6 Torr pressure belongs to substrate cleaning; deposition pressure is not silently inherited.
Nanocrystalline grain diameter, film thickness and unmeasured antiphase-domain size are distinct.
No sample-measured atomic coordinates or exact antiphase-boundary structure is supplied.
Source-qualified molecular/solid cards, deposition apparatus and film morphology refinements remain presentation pending.
